title: Rule of 👍 when posting to main #IndieWeb chat... If someone who has never built a website stopped by could they understand my post? If answer no post
summary: Rule of 👍 when posting to main #IndieWeb chat... If someone who has never built a website stopped by could they understand my post? If answer no post probably belongs in another channel. Our front door. Make it inviting to all. Jargon says, "No Trespassing"
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Rule of 👍 when posting to main #IndieWeb chat... If someone who has never built a website stopped by could they understand my post?

If answer no post probably belongs in another channel.

Our front door. Make it inviting to all. Jargon says, "No Trespassing"
